Hi Sara — thanks for letting us know and I'm so sorry you're feeling ill.

We appreciate the offer to do a short screen. We're happy to convert the loop into two shorter sessions today at the same time (11:00 PT): 11:00–11:20 with Dev for systems, then 11:20–11:40 with Marissa for frontend/behavioral. Jonas will do a 5-minute intro/close.

We'd like your permission to record the call for interviewer calibration. If you're not comfortable with recording, no problem — we will take detailed notes instead. Please reply with either (a) \"I consent to recording\" or (b) \"Please do not record\" and confirm the best phone number to reach you at 11:00.

Bridge details are attached (audio + Zoom dial-in). We'll keep things light and wish you a speedy recovery. If at any point you want to postpone, say the word and we'll find another slot.

Get well,
Hannah
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
